action.name: Padless HyperBoost firmware auto-exit on Battery
action.value: Apply paired mode 7 once on FullPower330W, switch to Battery, observe paired thermal state for ten seconds without an OpenBlade disable, then reconnect full power and restore the exact Balanced baseline if required

validation.applyResult: Applied successfully once from the confirmed Balanced and Automatic baseline on FullPower330W.
validation.readbackResult: Confirmed paired mode 7 before the transition, then confirmed BatterySaverAutomatic for all twenty Battery samples without an OpenBlade disable or HyperBoost re-entry.
validation.restorationResult: Restored successfully to the exact saved Balanced pair with one bounded paired cleanup after admitted full power was freshly reconfirmed.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: Confirmed exact Balanced restoration, final physical pad absence, and no indeterminate write or manual recovery state.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: The validator used the hash-pinned ten-second boundary plan with 500 ms cadence, three consecutive automatic samples required, no OpenBlade disable during observation, and full-power reconnection before cleanup.
After paired mode-7 confirmation, the firmware changed both thermal channels to BatterySaverAutomatic and maintained that state for every Battery sample without an OpenBlade disable.

After the observation, FullPower330W was freshly confirmed before any cleanup. The exact original Balanced pair had not yet returned, so OpenBlade issued one two-channel cleanup and confirmed restoration.
The private transcript remains uncommitted; this annotation retains its hash and length plus the exact Capture executable and final read-only Balanced confirmation.

limitations: This one exact-host run proves firmware auto-exit after a FullPower330W-to-Battery transition; it does not prove that a direct HyperBoost enable attempted while already on Battery is rejected.
The semantic thermal state confirms mode exit, not physical power limits, temperatures, or performance behavior.
The exact original Balanced pair did not return immediately after full power was reconnected, so the validator used its authorized one-shot paired cleanup.
The result is scoped to the exact RZ09-0581, BIOS 4.00 evidence provenance, Balanced and Automatic baseline, and confirmed physical cooling-pad absence.

productionAdmission.reason: The firmware independently exited mode 7 and maintained BatterySaverAutomatic for the complete observation. The reviewed policy therefore relies on firmware for Battery exit and permits HyperBoost to persist on any external-power class, including USB-C.

notes: The OpenBlade service and competing Razer applications remained inactive.
No Razer service was started, stopped, or restored.
